channel.description: Latest articles from Aboriginal Peoples Television Network (aptntv.ca)

item.title: Poke
item.description: New Week, New Laughs, New Hot Takes. Watch Poke’n the Bear on APTN Languages in Blackfoot! “Poke’n the Bear” is a bold and unfiltered Blackfoot talk show where former tribal police officer and spiritual leader Rod Scout takes on cultural and community issues with sharp humour and fearless honesty. The post About Poke’n the Bear appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Tiiturta
item.description: New Inuit Youth Story Every Week on APTN Languages. “Tiiturta” is a youth-focused variety show that explores Inuit history, culture and contemporary issues. Each episode highlights the perspectives of youth from across Inuit Nunangat, fostering pride, connection and learning among Inuit. The post About Tiiturta appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Taken
item.description: The Investigation Continues! New Episode Every Week on APTN and APTN Languages. “Taken” is a true crime documentary series that investigates cases of missing and murdered Indigenous Peoples in Canada. Through interviews, reenactments and expert insights, it honours victims, exposes systemic injustices and amplifies the call for justice. The post About Taken appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Searchers
item.description: The Search Continues. New Episodes Weekly on APTN! “Searchers” is a documentary series that immerses viewers in real-life rescue missions through gripping reenactments and intimate interviews, capturing each search with cinematic intensity and emotional depth. The post About Searchers appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Stuff the British Stole
item.description: Unravel the Mysteries Behind History’s Six Iconic Stolen Objects. Coming to APTN this January 5! Follow Marc Fennell on a globe-trotting, emotional quest for the truth as he unravels the twisted mysteries behind six iconic and priceless objects that the British Empire stole — and meets those who want the objects back. The post About Stuff the British Stole appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Pitago Stop
item.description: Plus de rires chaque semaine au Pitago Stop! « Pitago Stop » est une série de fiction humoristique de style « mocumentaire » qui met en scène le quotidien des employé·e·s d’une halte routière dans la communauté anishinaabe de Weymistis. The post À propos Pitago Stop appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Life Below Zero Canada
item.description: From long, frozen winters to sweltering, bug-infested summers, “Life Below Zero: Canada” captures the day-to-day trials of people who live in unforgiving environments. Follow the cast as they survive in the coldest and most remote regions of Northern Canada. The post About Life Below Zero Canada appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Animal Nation
item.description: An immersive look at wildlife through Indigenous knowledge. Animal Nation Premieres January 8 on APTN! “Animal Nation” explores the bear, beaver, bison, caribou, eagle, salmon and wolf as ecological and cultural icons in Indigenous communities. The post About Animal Nation appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Hoop Nations
item.description: New Stories Weekly on APTN! “Hoop Nations” is a documentary series that follows the journey of Indigenous basketball players prepping to showcase their talents at various tournaments, where they hope to fulfil their dreams of making it to the next level. The post About Hoop Nations appeared first on APTN.

item.title: Chaos and Courage
item.description: Season 1 of “Chaos & Courage” explores the personal and professional lives of Indigenous women working on the frontlines in Canada as RCMP officers, tribal police officers, paramedics, urban rescue workers and firefighters. The post About Chaos and Courage appeared first on APTN.
